attrs.evidence: emission_conformance.mjs 9/9 over 8 fixtures (const 0/1/3, add(0,1), add(2,3), nested add, one port, the I-4c asymmetric two-port binding). E-1 determinism end to end, bytes AND kernel-minted id checked separately; E-2 every receipt verified through makeEmissionVerifier({canonicaliseTarget}) and the direct entry point; E-3 the shared closed template, which this case REQUIRED TO BE DISTINCT in its first draft and failed, which is how the property was found; E-F1 a structural alternate moves the id on all 5 applicable fixtures and is refused, with the 3 const-only fixtures REPORTED rather than counted as passes; E-F2 a receipt does not verify against a neighbouring closed template; E-F3 the relation id is committed and a missing field is refused at construction; E-8 the same alternate differs in id and agrees in decoded outcome, with the alpha-equivalence measurement reported beside it; E-9 the integration theorem, 8/8 source outcome == decoded target outcome, labelled and last. THREE INSTRUMENT DEFECTS WERE FOUND BY THE CASES FAILING, and each is recorded where it happened: the label-shift adversary moved nothing, the closed-template swap read the SOURCE AST's vocabulary and matched no fixture (so E-F1 passed vacuously over an empty set until a >=4 floor caught it), and E-9 decoded the EMITTED term rather than its normal form and reported 0/8 with a populated target column, which reads like a target defect and was an instrument defect.
attrs.revision_note: SUPERSEDED by @2 at round 27 pass B6.1, kept as history. Nothing it claims is wrong; it is narrower in one place and mislabelled in another. It framed the identities as TWO properties in tension where there are THREE in a ladder, and its fixture family called add(x,y){x:2,y:3} the I-4c witness when that is precisely the SYMMETRIC fixture I-4c rejects.
attrs.statement: THE CANONICAL EMITTER DETERMINISTICALLY REALISES ITS DECLARED RELATION, over a FAMILY of fixtures rather than the one witness it had. closed_template_sem_id -(emission_sem_id)-> target_term_sem_id, and a conformance record is those three fields and no more: the relation's id is CONSTANT across every fixture, because a per-fixture emission id would identify invocations rather than the relation -- instantiation-identity@1's finding, one relation downstream. VERIFICATION IS BY RECONSTRUCTION AND NOT BY SELF-AGREEMENT: the verifier rebuilds the closed template from (program, inputs), re-emits through the canonical emitter, and canonicalises with an oracle IT WAS HANDED rather than one the emitter chose. An emitter that produced the artifact and certified its identity would verify a wrong emission against itself. EMISSION IS A FUNCTION OF THE CLOSED TEMPLATE AND NOT OF THE PROGRAM, which the family MEASURES rather than assumes: add(const 2, const 3) and add(input x, input y) closed with {x:2,y:3} are THE SAME CLOSED TEMPLATE and emit identically. Instantiation has already erased the difference between a literal and a port bound to that literal, and an emitter producing different bytes for those two would be reading something it is not entitled to see. The check is the implication in the direction that can be wrong -- equal domain implies equal codomain, different domain implies no collision -- rather than a blanket injectivity claim that would be false. TWO PROPERTIES THAT LOOK CONTRADICTORY ARE PROVED SEPARATELY. CANONICAL DETERMINISM: a structural change to the emitter moves target_term_sem_id and the receipt carrying it is REFUSED. SEMANTIC EQUIVALENCE: that same alternate emitter's output decodes to the same outcome. The first says the relation is a function; the second says target_term_sem_id identifies THIS emitter's output rather than the term's meaning. Collapsing them yields either 'reordering is a semantic change' or 'emission may drift as long as the answer matches', and the second is how a compiler stops being reproducible quietly. AND THE MUTATION THAT EXHIBITS THE PAIR HAD TO BE MEASURED. An ALPHA-EQUIVALENT alternate emitter produces the IDENTICAL target_term_sem_id on every fixture -- the canonical signature is byte-equivariant under alpha-renaming and label permutation by asserted law (L-BYTES-1) -- so renaming cannot witness this at all and the adversary must be STRUCTURAL. Reordering add's operands is meaning-preserving on THIS fragment because addition commutes, and would not be for a non-commutative operator; the caveat is part of the law rather than a footnote to it. NO NATIVE FILM IS REQUIRED OR USED. The transition relation carries its own evidence, and defining the emitter's correctness by what its output computes would put the runtime inside the compiler's contract -- the layer collapse lowering_spike.layer_separation exists to refuse. A downstream composition runs last and is LABELLED an integration theorem; every conformance case stands without it.
